centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working is the tender emotional: letting vulnerability, need, and gentleness appear. Not as weakness — as truth.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: Wanting too much, too strong, too intense. An appetite that covers a forbidden vulnerability. You take up space so as not to be taken. You lead so as not to be led.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Being controlled, dominated, betrayed, caught off guard.

essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to harden to be strong — your tenderness IS your strength.
horizons: Letting a tender belly be seen
Receiving gentleness without judging it weak
Feeling the other as an equal, not a threat

intentions_du_matin: Let something happen without controlling it
Recognize a tender need — and honor it
Feel rising vulnerability, without hardening it
Touch the right measure in a spending
Let someone protect you for a moment
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, ask for something gently — without imposing it.
When the reflex to counterattack rises, breathe three times and listen to what truly hurts.
An activity where you're not the leader. Follow. See how that feels.
Feel a need (hunger, fatigue, lack) and respond to it gently. Not by force.
Receive a sign of affection without deflecting it with a joke.
Say 'I don't know' once, without compensating for it.

zones.description: Innocent strength. You protect without dominating. You decide without imposing. Your felt vulnerability nourishes your true power.
You lead, you decide — you feel hardness rising and you can choose to listen first.
The gut leads. You dominate, intimidate, deny what hurts. The armor hardens.
Tyranny, vengeance, icy isolation. Tenderness is entirely banished. A very heavy day that calls for a gentle, steady witness.

details_riso.texte: Magnanimous, protective, courageous. Your strength serves life. You protect the weak because you recognize your own tenderness.
Decisive, confident, assertive. You take a stand without crushing.
Natural leader, builder, organizer. Action embodied.
Assertive, pragmatic. You begin to subtly dominate situations.
Self-centered, domineering, provocative. You show your strength. Vulnerability is denied.
Confrontational, aggressive, contemptuous of weakness. You intimidate.
Cruel, authoritarian, vengeful. The armor becomes plating.
Brutal, destructive, megalomaniac. You attack out of fear of being attacked.
Sociopathy, destruction of self and others. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I dominated a situation by reflex
I intimidated someone — a little, a lot
passions.detail: So as not to be touched.

passions.label: I denied something tender in myself
I did too much, with force, in quantity
I controlled so as not to be controlled

pieges.label: I didn't truly listen
pieges.detail: I was waiting for my turn to respond.

pieges.label: I used irony so as not to feel
I refused help that was offered
I unloaded anger on the wrong target

moments.label: I let my tenderness be seen
I felt my vulnerability, without hardening it
I touched an innocence in myself — that wasn't naivety

remedes.label: The right measure — instead of excess
Just strength — that protects, not that crushes

matin: Morning begins. What gentleness can you let in?
A day opens up — where could you listen before acting?
What vulnerability do you want to honor?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Has the armor shifted?
Here you are. Does someone deserve your tenderness, now?
A possible pause. Without having to take up space.
soir: The day is fading. Did you let a bit of your tender belly show?
You can simply arrive, without dominating anything.
Evening is gentle. The right strength, that's very good.
nuit: Night keeps watch. A gentle request, then sleep.
You are still here, without having to defend it.
